Path 2, MCP managementGOALS §3.5

Obot

An MCP catalog and gateway, with permissions from the directory.

WHAT IT IS

An MIT-licensed platform combining an MCP server catalog, hosting on Docker or Kubernetes, an MCP gateway and an LLM gateway. Production installs need Kubernetes and PostgreSQL.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Governance first: one catalog of approved servers, access granted by directory group. Access control is per server and catalog; detailed logging relies on Kubernetes tooling.

WHERE WE STAND

In a two-week bake-off against ToolHive. Decide the enforcement point before the product.

Our show notes; vendor comparisons (directional)

DECIDE

Obot: An MCP catalog and gateway, with permissions from the directory. Where we stand: In a two-week bake-off against ToolHive. Decide the enforcement point before the product. Our notes called it 'AD-managed MCP permissions', which is exactly the problem it targets.
